entries.prompt: Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 educational object illustration in coloured semi-realistic bande dessinée style, fine clean outlines and carefully shaded objects. Pure solid WHITE background (#FFFFFF) extending to every edge, no scenery, no table edge, no horizon, no textured or coloured background, no surface other than the seamless white backdrop. Opaque white background, not transparency. Very soft minimal contact shadows only. No humans, no hands, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Every object is wholly visible with ample white margin, isolated and easy to recognise. EXACTLY 5 distinct ripe red tomatoes, with small green calyxes. Arrange in one row of three and one row of two. Keep large white gaps between every object, no overlaps, no stacking, no cropping. The exact count 5 is essential: do not add or omit any. All objects of comparable size.
